events.headline: INCIDENT
events.description: Washout at Silver Skagit Road, In Hope. Last update: September 15th, 2026 at 8:01pm PDT. Next update: March 1st, 2027 at 11:00am MST. Road has been impacted by washout, repairs are underway. Expect delays in both directions and drive with caution.
